race.comment: Keen on JETT SMASH (7), noting that this race is on the Lakeside circuit. He's racing very well this time in, dominant first up at Flemington then heavily backed over 1440m at Caulfield when doing early work. He made Fundamental Nature stretch to beat him last time and that mare has bolted in again since. Back to 1200m suits, he gets in on the minimum and handles wet ground. Rolls across for Lane and might just be too slick. PHOTOGRAPH (4) continues to race very well without winning, competitive in black type races over the carnival. If she can hold a spot from barrier one she'll go well. KARREN (10) is a progressive mare off a nice win last start, she can measure up. TRES MAGNIFIQUE (9) is consistent and the market loves her but she's been suspect at the end of 1100m lately so the rise in trip is a huge worry.
